title: Molarity / Mass for Target Molarity

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Calculates how much solute mass is needed to prepare a solution of a specific molar concentration and volume, based on the solute's molecular weight.

workedExample.scenario: Preparing 1 L of a 0.1 M solution of a solute with molecular weight 58.44 g/mol (e.g. sodium chloride).

commonMistakes: Not correcting for reagent purity (%) or hydration state (e.g. a hydrate salt's molecular weight includes water of crystallization) when the reagent label specifies either.
